core_obligations: Observe that the value of O on any object of the category is a polynomial algebra over Lambda, hence Omega_{O/Lambda} is flat, giving the second and third equalities (proof lines 4718-4724).

Use the computation remark to express Lpi_!(Omega_{O/Lambda} tensor O_X) as the sheafification of the presheaf U -> Omega_{P_bullet,U/Lambda} tensor O_X(U) = L_{O_X(U)/Lambda} (proof lines 4727-4739).
Apply the section-level remark to identify this with the cotangent complex of the ring map Lambda -> O_X on X_etale (proof lines 4740-4744).
Conclude by the space-over-ring lemma (proof lines 4744-4745).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the lemma there is a canonical isomorphism L_{X/Lambda} = Lpi_!(Li^*Omega_{O/Lambda}) = Lpi_!(i^*Omega_{O/Lambda}) = Lpi_!(Omega_{O/Lambda} tensor O_X) in D(O_X) (source lines 4705-4716). The proof first notes that the value of the sheaf O on any object of the category C_{X/Lambda} is a polynomial algebra over Lambda, so that Omega_{O/Lambda} is flat and the second and third equalities hold; then it uses the remark computing Lpi_! as the sheafification of an explicit complex of presheaves whose value on U is the ring-level complex L_{O_X(U)/Lambda}, and identifies it with the cotangent complex of the ring map Lambda -> O_X on X_etale via the section-level remark and the space-over-ring lemma.
